note: FNS 1061.2 applies exclusively to households participating under retrospective eligibility, which is part of the Monthly Reporting and Retrospective Budgeting (MRRB) system. Massachusetts does not use MRRB. The 106 CMR establishes only Change Reporting (366.110) and Simplified Reporting (366.110(B)-(D), 366.910) systems, all using prospective budgeting. The OLG confirms this: all income budgeting procedures reference prospective calculations (the Prospective tab in BEACON for earned and unearned income). FNS Section 700 states that 'Retrospective eligibility and budgeting systems are used exclusively in monthly reporting systems,' and FNS Section 130 defines retrospective eligibility as 'only utilized for households certified under a MRRB system.' Since MA elected not to implement MRRB, this FNS requirement has no application to MA's SNAP program, and the OLG's exclusive focus on prospective budgeting is correct.
